spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.desc: Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.desc: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Sunbeam
spells.desc: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 radiant damage and is blinded until your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't blinded by this spell.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.desc: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. It takes 2d10 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.desc: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.desc: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.desc: Each creature in a 10-­--foot-­--radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.

spells.name: Light
spells.desc: Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.desc: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.desc: On a failed save, the target takes 10d6 + 40 force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of force, this spell disintegrates a 10-foot-cube portion of it.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.desc: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting form a point within range.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.desc: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. The creature takes 2d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If you ram the sphere into a creature, that creature must make the saving throw against the sphere's damage, and the sphere stops moving this turn.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.desc: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes fire damage equal to the total accumulated damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The spell's base damage is 12d6.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.desc: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Silence
spells.desc: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it.

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.desc: You can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot cube, or eight connected 5-foot cubes), given a sufficient quantity of raw material. If you are working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium (contained within a single 5-foot cube).

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.desc: Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.desc: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

spells.name: Web
spells.desc: The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point for the duration. Any 5-foot cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.desc: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see 100 feet directly above you. A creature takes 3d10 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Under such conditions, the spell's damage increases by 1d10.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.desc: Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.desc: A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target.
